label: bol Retail Media (Sponsored Products)
terms_note: Advertising API access uses the Retailer API client credentials and intermediary authorisation flow (read on the API overview).

discovery.auth: jwt (same client credentials / intermediary authorization flow as the Retailer API)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (bol Advertising API v11) Confidence: **high** — official docs read.
auth: 1. Seller dashboard → API settings → client credentials (or intermediary authorization for agencies).
2. `POST https://login.bol.com/token?grant_type=client_credentials` (Basic auth) → JWT (the 'same method of authentication as the standard intermediary authorization flow').

Budget Management: Campaign Budgets · Account Budgets · Budget Settings · Free Credits
Reporting API · Bulk Reporting API (async, Process Status) · Share of Voice · Insights API

reference.limits: - Rate limits per resource (Active rate limits page); versioning per resource; release lifecycle + beta program; free; bol Partner API terms.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client id of bol API credentials with Advertising API access (seller dashboard > Settings > API settings, or intermediary authorization for agencies); exchanged at POST https://login.bol.com/token (grant_type=client_credentials, HTTP Basic) for a ~5-minute JWT.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The matching client secret. The JWT is cached and re-requested before expiry (bol bans IPs that request a token per call).

me.note: There is no account endpoint; the probe is GET /advertiser/sponsored-products/budget-management/budget-settings ({mode: BASIC|ADVANCED}), which verifies the JWT has Advertising API access.

list_campaigns.note: POST /advertiser/sponsored-products/campaign-management/campaigns/list {filter: {states: [status]}, page, pageSize (≤100)}. status is ENABLED, PAUSED or ARCHIVED. `budget` is the daily budget in EUR (totalBudget, campaignType AUTO|MANUAL, targetCountries NL/BE and constraints such as OUT_OF_DAILY_BUDGET in raw). `account_id` is not sent (the JWT selects the retailer account).

get_report.note: GET /advertiser/sponsored-products/reporting/performance?entity-type=CAMPAIGN&entity-ids=<campaign_id>&period-start-date&period-end-date: one aggregated row for the campaign over the period (dates within the last 30 days, inclusive). campaign_id is REQUIRED (entity-ids is mandatory; the account-level /performance/advertiser returns a single total, not rows). cost in EUR; conversions and sales are 14-day attributed.

not_offered.list_accounts: The JWT belongs to one retailer account; the Advertising API has no account list (https://api.bol.com/retailer/public/Retailer-API/v11/functional/advertising-api/aapi-overview.html: authorization 'uses the same method of authentication as the standard intermediary authorization flow').
not_offered.update_budget: PUT /campaign-management/campaigns replaces campaigns: each item requires campaignId plus name, startDate, targetCountries, targetChannels, campaignType and state (UpdateCampaignsRequest, https://api.bol.com/advertiser/docs/redoc/sponsored-products/v11/campaign-management.html). Changing only dailyBudget would need a read-modify-write the runtime cannot do.
not_offered.pause_resume: Same PUT /campaign-management/campaigns full-object update (state ENABLED|PAUSED alongside the required name, startDate, targetCountries, targetChannels, campaignType); no partial state endpoint (https://api.bol.com/advertiser/docs/redoc/sponsored-products/v11/campaign-management.html).

evidence: host api.bol.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
